label: SLC44A1::PRKCA

sections.text: PRKCA encodes protein kinase C alpha, a calcium- and diacylglycerol-regulated serine/threonine kinase.
The fusion joins SLC44A1 to a retained PRKCA kinase region, altering normal PKC regulation. It is a recurrent defining molecular alteration of papillary glioneuronal tumor.
